children: China's retail consumption likely remained soft in August, according to BofA Securities in a research note. Retail sales growth is expected to stay at 0.6% year-over-year. Auto sales volume continued to contract sharply, down 19% year-over-year, according to the China Passenger Car Association, while home appliance demand remained under pressure. In addition, services PMI held at only 49.3 last month, the bank says. This suggests consumer confidence and discretionary spending have yet to see a meaningful recovery, BofA says. (tracy.qu@wsj.com)
